sources.entry: Jutsu Studio - Unofficial Higgsfield client for creating AI videos and images with Seedance, Kling and Genjutsu, with every result kept on your disk.

summary.one_liner: Jutsu Studio is an unofficial, open-source native macOS app for making AI videos and images with Higgsfield models (Genjutsu, Seedance, Kling, and others) and saving every result to your disk.
summary.what_it_does: Jutsu Studio is a Mac app for generating video and images with Higgsfield's models, including Genjutsu, Seedance 2.5, Kling 4.0 and 3.0, Wan 3.0, and Cinema Studio 4.0. You can drop a MOV, HEVC or ProRes file or paste a link, then trim a 4–30 second range; only that range is uploaded. Jobs run in the background with a menu bar indicator and notifications, and resume after a restart or dropped connection. Each result is downloaded to ~/Movies/Jutsu Studio/Videos with its source, references, prompt and cost. The app shows the price of each job before you run it, offers an optional daily spending cap, and can export ProRes 422 or H.264 for Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro. Access uses either a Higgsfield sign-in over OAuth or an API key, stored in the macOS Keychain.
use_cases: generate AI video clips from a prompt and images
restyle or swap objects in an existing video
batch several takes of a clip with cheap draft renders
keep a local archive of Higgsfield generations
export AI video to a non-linear editor
run a budget-capped AI video workflow on a Mac
how_to_run: Alternatively, download Jutsu-Studio .dmg from the latest GitHub release, open it and drag Jutsu Studio to Applications
Connect Higgsfield via sign-in in the browser (OAuth through Higgsfield's MCP server) or paste an API key from the Higgsfield console
Drop a video, pick a 4–30 s range, add a character image or restyle preset, check the price, and click Draft 480p
stack: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 speech model (Core ML, optional download)
notable: Keeps a local copy of every result with its source, prompt and cost, since Higgsfield links expire
Uploads only the trimmed range of a source video, so cut seconds are not paid for
Shows the cost of each button before generation and supports an optional daily cap
No Jutsu backend, no accounts and no telemetry; the app talks directly to Higgsfield
Exports ProRes 422 or H.264 with take names that sort in order for common editors
caveats: Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later; Apple silicon and Intel are supported
Unofficial and not affiliated with Higgsfield AI; generations are billed to the user's own Higgsfield account at list prices
Some features need a Higgsfield account plan or an API key (for example, Kling 2.6 Motion Control and Wan 2.7 need an API key)
Generation runs on Higgsfield's servers, so source videos, reference images and prompts are uploaded for each job
